{{Quote|Oh, there goes Quadinaros' power coupling!|[[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]]|audio=Annodue-PowerCoupling.flac|<ref name="Episode 1">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
'''Ben Quadinaros''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Toong/Legends|Toong]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tund/Legends|Tund]], and operated as a [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] pilot during the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|What's the matter? Your pit droid take a day off?|Quadinaros taunts another racer|translated=1|audio=BenQuadrinaros-taunt.flac|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Toong_AA.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ben Quadinaros.]]
Quadinaros was known as something of a coward, though this was not entirely accurate. However, like most Toongs, he buckled under when confronted with social interaction. His timidity around others quickly earned him an undeserved reputation as a coward, and while he might not have been spineless, he lacked the skill required to achieve success in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]]. Quadinaros had only raced previously on the [[Pouffra Circuit]], widely regarded as one of the safest, and therefore in the collective opinion of the Podracing elite, wimpiest, courses in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Quadinaros would not have entered the Boonta at all if not for the fact that [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor]], in his [[Glimmik/Legends|glimmik]] concert the night before the race, had drunkenly bet five million [[Peggat/Legends|peggats]] that Quadinaros didn't have the guts to enter. The Toong accepted his bet, rented a [[BT310 Quadra/Legends|BT310]], and soon found himself on the starting grid of the racetrack. He couldn't deny feeling great fear that he might meet his end on the unforgiving dunes of the Boonta. However, he was spared a grisly fate when his Podracer failed to take off at the start of the race. The racer's power couplings failed while the racer was turned on, and the engines shot off in different directions, with Ben being tugged up only a few meters. It transpired that Quadinaros' racer had been sabotaged by [[Ark Roose/Legends|Ark "Bumpy" Roose]] prior to the start of the contest, and was not a radical design flaw, as originally rumored. Although Ben's piloting skills certainly remained unproven at this point, the potential of the BT310 was certainly not, being one of the most powerful single-repulsor craft ever made. This was a machine designed to break barriers, in speed and design alike, but was an unusual rental choice for a novice pilot.

Deprived of his dignity, yet five million peggats richer as a result of his bet with Roor, Quadinaros happily stepped down from the expert courses, purchased a new Podracer, and returned to the Pouffra Circuit.

He became the race champion on the [[Ceyan Range Raceway]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]<ref name="Racer Rush">{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/racer-rush|text=Racer Rush|int=Racer Rush}}</ref> as well as on the [[Inferno (track)|Inferno circuit]] on [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]], despite the latter being more dangerous than the Pouffra.

Even as he supported his family, he pressed ahead with his career as a racing driver during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. While discharged on [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], he was able to qualify for the finals, which he won, and was celebrated afterward for his victory. However this was due to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Padawan [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], along with a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] podracer [[Kidd Kareen]], fighting [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[San Maxus]] over for the sensitive Republic [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] in a [[Datacard/Legends|data disk]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:BT310QuadraMosEspaGrandArena-TPM.png|thumb|right|200px|Quadinaros's rented BT310 podracer.]]
In his computer game appearances, he was voiced by [[Dominic Armato]].

Quadinaros meets a rather different fate in the [[Star Wars: Episode I — The Phantom Menace (comic series)|comic adaptation]] of the film, where his Podracer starts without any trouble, but explodes after being rammed by [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] craft.

In ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', players could race several [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] race tracks and try to get the daily track record to receive a badge. If no player had yet completed the track on that day, the race coordinator would tell the player that Ben Quadinaros is the current record holder.
